cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One painting. That's all I finished for our exhibition. You're usually the one asking me if you've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep the spacing we practised. Don't rearrange your work to disguise mine. Tell me whether this one deserves to be here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. Will you introduce me as the other painter, then? I'd like to hear my best pupil say that.
